extracted.name: Garlic Mashed Potatoes Secret Recipe
extracted.description: Red potatoes mashed with butter, Romano cheese, garlic, salt and oregano. A new twist on a familiar favorite!
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and cook until tender but still firm, about 45 minutes; drain. Stir in butter, cheese, garlic, salt and oregano. Mash with a potato masher or with an electric mixer.
